_comment: Browser logins: sites that have no API to grant, so sudo drives a real browser instead.
Each recipe is a hint set, not a promise. detection is tried in order: logged_in first,
then logged_out, otherwise unknown -- 'unknown' is the honest answer when a site changes.
Selectors are deliberately few: one reliable marker beats five clever ones that rot.
Only add sites the owner actually asked for. Automating a login can break a site's terms;
banks, government ID portals and anything with money movement are out of scope on purpose.

usps.label: USPS
usps.note: Blocked from datacenter IPs; works from a home connection.

instagram.label: Instagram
instagram.note: Hostile to automation: expect a challenge. Manual login is the reliable path.

generic.label: Another site
generic.note: Owner supplies the URL; state stays 'unknown' until a marker is configured.
